{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D20","page":2,"quote":"⌀ 8 H7 THRU`"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N16","page":1,"quote":"FINISH : IZBP"}],"comment":"The ⌀8 H7 hole (D20) is a tight ISO fit on a part that receives zinc black passivation (IZBP per N16), but the drawing does not state whether the plating thickness is allowed for or if the hole must be masked. Without this, the coating will reduce the bore size and may prevent assembly with the mating pin. The designer should add a note specifying masking of the H7 hole during plating or provide an adjusted pre-plate tolerance to accommodate the coating thickness."

,"recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'MASK ⌀8 H7 HOLE DURING IZBP' or specify the pre-plating dimension accounting for coating thickness."}]}
